neighbours.label: the word-initial piece 'ex' / 'Ex' (exclamation, exotic, exterior, ex = ... in code)
fire: Children are learning to use exclamation marks in their stories.
The market sells exotic fruits from all over the world.
We painted the exterior of the house a pale blue.
The farmers had to export most of the harvest last year.
Her ex-husband moved to another city after the divorce.
Exterior lights should be checked before winter.
The museum will exhibit the paintings until March.
quiet: Children are learning to use question marks in their stories.
The market sells fresh fruits from all over the world.
We painted the walls of the house a pale blue.
The farmers had to sell most of the harvest last year.
Her former husband moved to another city after the divorce.
Outdoor lights should be checked before winter.
The museum will show the paintings until March.
